title: Man found dead inside garbage bag in Canarsie, Brooklyn
text:
Man found dead inside garbage bag in Canarsie, Brooklyn - ABC7 New York 
 24/7 Live New York City New Jersey Long Island Northern Suburbs Connecticut Man found dead inside garbage bag in Brooklyn 
 Friday, October 30, 2026 7:37PM 
 Authorities are still working to identify the body. WABC CANARSIE, Brooklyn (WABC) -- A man's body was found inside a black garbage bag Friday morning in Brooklyn's Canarsie neighborhood after a man looking for scrap metal flagged down a sanitation truck.
 The discovery happened around 9:30 a.m. at the corner of East 93rd Street and Avenue L. Cellphone video showed the sanitation truck at the scene after the body was found.
 NewsCopter 7 footage showed an expanding crime scene stretching several blocks. Police vehicles eventually blocked the white sheet covering the body from public view.
 Police said the victim appeared to be a man in his 50s or 60s.
 The discovery left some residents shaken.
 "Yeah, that was horrible. And a lot of the seniors were crying. Yeah. Because, you know, that could be my child or someone else's child," Linda McKnight said.
 Surveillance video showed two men driving a sedan, removing the body from the trunk around 1:30 a.m. and then driving away.
 It appears the man who found the bag dragged it for a block before realizing it contained a body.
 A witness named Rachel said the discovery was especially unsettling given the time of year.
 "I just thought it was really eerie. It's Halloween...it's just shocking. It's not every day you see a body on the ground bloated up and, you know, covered with a white sheet," she said.
 The investigation remained ongoing Friday.
